description: Polish the OverviewTab and ActivityTab sections inside app/(tabs)/index.tsx. Changes: statCard border to hairlineWidth, progressLabel color token fix, activity date text removal of .toUpperCase(), activityDate style refinement, empty activity state styling, and lineHeight compliance fixes across several styles. Does NOT touch the StatisticsTab, BestHoursChartRN, TopicBalanceRN, or TimeTrackingCard (all already done in FEAT-002). Independent of FEAT-003 (different files), but should be applied after FEAT-003 is committed.
steps: 1. Ensure branch 'feat/dashboard-ui-refinement' is checked out and FEAT-003 is already committed: git -C /Users/parteek.kumar/Dev/common-tasks/daily-planner log --oneline -3

2. Read the FULL file app/(tabs)/index.tsx before making any changes — it is large (~1300 lines). Pay careful attention to the 's = StyleSheet.create({})' block at the bottom (shared styles used by all inline sub-components). Do NOT modify the 'st = StyleSheet.create({})' block (screen-level styles, already correct).
3. In the 's = StyleSheet.create({})' block, make these changes to existing styles:
a. statCard: change borderWidth from 1 to StyleSheet.hairlineWidth
b. statCardLabel: add lineHeight: 14 (fontSize 10 → min 14)
c. statLabel: add lineHeight: 14 (fontSize 10 → min 14)
d. statSub: add lineHeight: 16 (fontSize 11 → min 16)
e. progressLabel: add lineHeight: 18 (fontSize 12 → min 18)
f. sevenDow: add lineHeight: 18 (fontSize 12 → min 18)
g. activityDate: change fontWeight from '700' to '600'; remove letterSpacing: 0.4; add lineHeight: 16
h. activityCount: add lineHeight: 16 (fontSize 11 → min 16)
i. emptyActivity: add lineHeight: 20 (fontSize 14 → min 20)
4. In the 's = StyleSheet.create({})' block, add a new style key after emptyActivity:
emptyActivitySub: { fontSize: 12, lineHeight: 18, marginTop: 4, textAlign: 'center' as any }
(The 'as any' cast is needed because StyleSheet.create type is strict about textAlign on some RN versions.)
5. In OverviewTab JSX, find the progress card 'Today's goal progress' text element and change its inline color token:
{ color: tokens.textMuted }  →  { color: tokens.textSecondary }
This is the <Text style={[s.progressLabel, { color: tokens.textMuted }]}> element (only one in OverviewTab).
6. In ActivityTab JSX, find the activityGroupHeader section. Change the activityDate Text content from '{dayLabel(ds).toUpperCase()}' to '{dayLabel(ds)}'. The colors and styles are unchanged.
7. In ActivityTab JSX, find the empty state block (activityGroups.length === 0 branch). Make two changes:
a. Change the outer View from: <View style={s.emptyActivityWrap}>
to: <View style={[s.emptyActivityWrap, { backgroundColor: tokens.bgInput, borderRadius: 12 }]}>
b. Change the second Text element (subtitle) from:
<Text style={{ fontSize: 12, color: tokens.textMuted, marginTop: 4, textAlign: 'center' }}>
to: <Text style={[s.emptyActivitySub, { color: tokens.textMuted }]}>
The text content 'Complete a task to see your activity here.' stays unchanged.

8. Run 'npx tsc --noEmit' from /Users/parteek.kumar/Dev/common-tasks/daily-planner. Fix any TypeScript errors. Common issue to watch for: if 'textAlign: center' causes a type error in StyleSheet.create, use 'textAlign: "center" as const'.
9. Run 'npx vitest --run' from /Users/parteek.kumar/Dev/common-tasks/daily-planner. All 18 tests must pass.
10. Stage only the one changed file: git add 'app/(tabs)/index.tsx'
11. Commit: git commit -m 'refactor(dashboard): polish OverviewTab and ActivityTab — hairline borders, sentence-case date labels, lineHeight compliance'. Record the commit hash in findings.
acceptance_criteria: s.activityDate has fontWeight: '600' (not '700'), no letterSpacing property, and lineHeight: 16
s.emptyActivitySub exists with fontSize: 12, lineHeight: 18, marginTop: 4, textAlign: 'center'
OverviewTab progressLabel uses { color: tokens.textSecondary } (not tokens.textMuted)
ActivityTab activityGroupHeader date renders dayLabel(ds) WITHOUT .toUpperCase() call
ActivityTab empty state View has backgroundColor: tokens.bgInput and borderRadius: 12 applied
ActivityTab empty state subtitle uses s.emptyActivitySub style (not raw inline fontSize/marginTop)
StatisticsTab, BestHoursChartRN, TopicBalanceRN, TimeTrackingCard are NOT modified
stat labels TODAY/STREAK/TIME INVESTED/COMPLETED still have letterSpacing: 0.7 (unchanged)
npx tsc --noEmit exits with zero errors
